description: Process and temperature controllers, 1/4, 1/16 and 1/8 DIN (RS485 option)
source: West, Controladores e Indicadores de 1/4 DIN, 1/8 DIN e 1/16 DIN - Manual do Produto (59305, edition 7, March 2014)

sources.title: Controladores e Indicadores de 1/4 DIN, 1/8 DIN e 1/16 DIN - Manual do Produto (Serie P Plus)

notes: Needs the RS485 communications module in option input A, with the protocol set to Modbus (not ASCII) in configuration mode.
Every value is a 16-bit integer and the decimal point follows the Decimal point position register: a PV of 235 with one decimal is 23.5. A scale of 1 means the raw integer.

Addresses are the Modbus parameter numbers printed in the manual. The manual does not say whether they are sent as is or minus one; if a read returns the neighbouring parameter, switch to address_base 1.
Writes need the front-panel Comms write setting to be read/write. Function 16 writes one word at a time; function 6 also works.
Flags are read with function 1/2 and written with function 5.
Not tested on a device. The P6170, P8170 and P4170 valve motor drive models use a different table and are not covered.

registers.name: Process variable
registers.description: Current PV. Raw 62976 is under range, 63232 over range and 63488 sensor break (read as int16: -2560, -2304, -2048)

registers.name: Target setpoint
registers.description: Selected setpoint. Read-only when the target is the remote setpoint

registers.name: Output power
registers.description: 0 to 100 % (single output) or -100 to +100 % (dual output). Writable only in manual control

registers.name: Deviation
registers.description: PV minus setpoint

registers.name: Actual setpoint
registers.description: Current setpoint value; follows the ramp while the setpoint ramp is active

registers.name: Remote setpoint
registers.description: Remote setpoint value. Reads 0xFFFF when no remote setpoint is fitted

registers.name: Input status
registers.description: Bit 0 sensor break, bit 1 under range, bit 2 over range

registers.name: Secondary proportional band
registers.description: 0.0 to 999.9 % of the input span. Read-only during auto-tune

registers.name: Primary proportional band
registers.description: 0.0 to 999.9 % of the input span. Read-only during auto-tune

registers.name: Control action
registers.description: 1 = direct action, 0 = reverse action

registers.name: Integral time
registers.description: Also the loop alarm time. Read-only during auto-tune

registers.name: Derivative time
registers.description: 0 to 5999 (99 min 59 s). Read-only during auto-tune

registers.name: Manual reset
registers.description: Bias, 0 to 100 % for a single output, -100 to +100 % for dual outputs

registers.name: Overlap / deadband
registers.description: -20 to +20 % of the sum of the two proportional bands; negative is deadband, positive is overlap

registers.name: On/off differential
registers.description: 0.1 to 10.0 % of the input span

registers.name: Output power limit
registers.description: Safety limit on the output power, 0 to 100 %

registers.name: Scale range lower limit
registers.description: Lower limit of the scaled input range

registers.name: Scale range upper limit
registers.description: Upper limit of the scaled input range

registers.name: Decimal point position
registers.description: Number of decimals of the process values. Only writable on a linear input

registers.name: Setpoint upper limit
registers.description: Highest setpoint that can be set

registers.name: Setpoint lower limit
registers.description: Lowest setpoint that can be set

registers.name: Setpoint ramp rate
registers.description: 0 = off, 1 to 9999 units per hour

registers.name: Setpoint selection
registers.description: Active setpoint. An assigned digital input takes priority over this value

registers.name: Remote setpoint offset
registers.description: Added to the remote setpoint, limited by the scale range

registers.name: Remote setpoint lower limit
registers.description: Value used when the remote setpoint input is at its minimum

registers.name: Remote setpoint upper limit
registers.description: Value used when the remote setpoint input is at its maximum

registers.name: Input filter time constant
registers.description: 0 to 100 s

registers.name: Process value offset
registers.description: Added to the PV, limited by the scale range

registers.name: Alarm 1 value
registers.description: Level at which alarm 1 trips

registers.name: Alarm 2 value
registers.description: Level at which alarm 2 trips

registers.name: Alarm 1 hysteresis
registers.description: 0 to 100 % of the span

registers.name: Alarm 2 hysteresis
registers.description: 0 to 100 % of the span

registers.name: Retransmit output 1 maximum
registers.description: Scale maximum of the first retransmission output, -1999 to 9999

registers.name: Retransmit output 1 minimum
registers.description: Scale minimum of the first retransmission output, -1999 to 9999

registers.name: Retransmit output 2 maximum
registers.description: Scale maximum of the second retransmission output, -1999 to 9999

registers.name: Retransmit output 2 minimum
registers.description: Scale minimum of the second retransmission output, -1999 to 9999

registers.name: Retransmit output 3 maximum
registers.description: Scale maximum of the third retransmission output, -1999 to 9999

registers.name: Retransmit output 3 minimum
registers.description: Scale minimum of the third retransmission output, -1999 to 9999

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: Bits 0-4 revision number, bits 5-9 alpha version (A = 0), bits 10-15 numeric version

registers.name: Product revision level
registers.description: Low byte alpha part (A = 1), high byte numeric part

registers.name: Manufacture date
registers.description: Binary coded month and year; 0403 (April 2003) reads as 0x0193

registers.name: Comms write enabled
registers.description: 1 = writes enabled, 0 = disabled (writes then get exception 3)

registers.name: Manual control
registers.description: 1 = manual control, 0 = automatic control

registers.name: Auto-tune
registers.description: 1 = on, 0 = off

registers.name: Pre-tune
registers.description: 1 = on, 0 = off

registers.name: Alarm 1 active
registers.description: 1 = active

registers.name: Alarm 2 active
registers.description: 1 = active

registers.name: Setpoint ramp enable
registers.description: 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled

registers.name: Loop alarm enable
registers.description: Read for the loop alarm state; write 1 to enable, 0 to disable

registers.name: Digital input 2
registers.description: State of the option B digital input
